title: NIRDPR Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Staff Nurse Posts
description: National Institute of Rural Development & Panchayati Raj (NIRDPR) has declared the official notification for 2026 to fill up the vacancies for various Staff Nurse Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.Sc. Nursing can grab this chance and apply for the NIRDPR Notification 2026 . Here, we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
